# proxmox_storage_volume (Resource)

Manages notes and the protected flag of an existing storage volume through `PUT /nodes/{node}/storage/{storage}/content/{volume}`. Create expects the volume to exist, destroy deletes it. Import as `<node>/<storage>/<volume>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "proxmox_storage_volume" "backup" {
  node      = "pve-1"
  storage   = "backup"
  volume    = "backup:backup/vzdump-qemu-300-2026_01_01-00_00_00.vma.zst"
  notes     = "keep for audit"
  protected = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) Cluster node.
- `storage` (String) Storage.
- `volume` (String) Volume identifier such as `local:iso/debian.iso`.

### Optional

- `notes` (String) Volume notes.
- `protected` (Boolean) Protect the volume from removal.

### Read-Only

- `format` (String) Volume format.
- `id` (String) Identifier in `<node>/<storage>/<volume>` form.
- `size` (Number) Volume size in bytes.
- `used` (Number) Used bytes.
